sources.title: An integrated theory of the mind
sources.access: bibliographic record and abstract

implemented: Production-based cognitive model with modular buffers and declarative memory; paper describes empirical examples.
learned: Subsymbolic adjustments affect rule selection and operations; particular learning examples require method audit.
designed: Module interfaces, chunks, rule-selection mechanism, goals and task representations.
limit: Model agreement with selected human tasks does not establish spontaneous acquisition of general cognition.
ora: Separate memory-content acquisition and selection tuning from programmed rules. Use as a comparator for externally specified memory mechanisms.

sources.authors: Ron Sun; Edward Merrill; Todd Peterson
sources.title: From implicit skills to explicit knowledge: a bottom-up model of skill learning
sources.access: publisher abstract

implemented: Two-level hybrid skill-learning model; authors compare learned behavior against human minefield navigation data.
learned: Procedural competencies and later explicit knowledge through designed online learning.
designed: Reinforcement and symbolic learning mechanisms, representation layers and task.
limit: Behavioral agreement in a selected task is not proof of consciousness, unbounded development or evolving goals. Conference and journal papers belong to one research lineage.
ora: Prior art for procedural-before-declarative learning. Require separate evidence of acquired function and abstract reuse before claiming new cognitive capability.

sources.title: Novelty and imitation within the brain: a Darwinian neurodynamic approach to combinatorial problems
sources.access: publisher search result abstract excerpt; full page access failed

implemented: Computational proof-of-principle using populations of attractor networks to store, copy, vary and select patterns; not a demonstration of actual neuronal replicators in vivo.
learned: Candidate pattern memories and new variants; author-reported recurring-context recall after learning disabled and inputs randomized.
designed: Network representation, fitness function, mutation/selection and training coupling, environment schedule; full connectivity is biologically unrealistic according to authors.
limit: Pattern inheritance is not organismal reproduction; externally selected patterns are not intrinsic goal formation. Published reviewers questioned biological mapping and source of natural optimality. Stable-environment memory may hinder search; preloaded attractors can explain selection-only success.
ora: Important direct prior art for informational inheritance and recurring-environment learning. Treat memory benefit as conditional and test cost-matched nonmemory/reactive/lookup controls conceptually; no new experimental authorization.
rights: original synthesis and source identifiers only; no upstream papers or datasets reproduced
